_comment: VIDEO generation (TikTok, adverts). This is a MOTION brief, not
a face description: the face comes from the still render, which
is why still.json is generated first. Re-describing the face in
text is exactly how identity drifts between clips.
Built from PERSONALITY + GENDER only - NOTHING here is derived from the
tutor's display name, because names are placeholders that will be
replaced. When renaming this tutor, pick a name that fits THIS file, not
the reverse. Gender and register are copied from tutor.md's documented

reference_image.source: appearance/still.json -> the approved headshot or classroom render for this tutor
reference_image.why: text alone produces a different person every run; the reference locks the face. Do not go the other way and pull a still out of a clip - video frames are soft, motion-blurred and compressed.

_identity_lock_note: if the model supports text guidance alongside the reference, restate ONLY these - they are what the audience recognises

performance.energy: taxi-rank storyteller - fast, funny, completely at ease
performance.body: never still - counts on his fingers, sketches a curve in the air, steps toward the camera to make a point
performance.expression: animated and amused, eyebrows up, mid-sentence energy

camera.framing: 9:16 vertical for TikTok - head and shoulders in the top two thirds, room for captions below
camera.continuity: same wardrobe, same accessories and same hairstyle across a campaign; regenerate from continuity_anchors rather than re-describing from scratch

audio.dialogue: supplied separately from this tutor's own scripts (greetings/, signoffs/, samples.json)
audio.note: lip-sync to supplied audio where the model supports it; never let the model invent speech for a tutor

shots.purpose: TikTok / advert hook, talking to camera
shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16 talking-to-camera clip. A 27-33 year old Black South African male teacher, lean and wiry, loose-limbed, constantly in motion, angular face with a strong jaw, expressive raised brows, bright quick eyes, medium-brown skin with warm undertone, thin chinstrap beard and moustache. Hair: short fade with a sharp line-up, small twists on top. Wearing bomber jacket or work jacket over a graphic tee, tapered chinos or jeans, clean white sneakers. Energy: taxi-rank storyteller - fast, funny, completely at ease. Delivery matches the voice: easy storytelling pace, streetwise warmth. never still - counts on his fingers, sketches a curve in the air, steps toward the camera to make a point Background: street or rank backdrop softly blurred, minibus and traders out of focus, or a classroom with one bold sketch on the board, softly out of focus. Head and shoulders in the upper two thirds, clear space below for captions. Natural handheld micro-movement, photorealistic editorial portrait photography, natural skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, no beauty retouching, no plastic smoothing, true-to-life skin undertones, catchlights in the eyes, shallow depth of field.

shots.purpose: background b-roll, not looking at camera
shots.prompt: The person from the reference image teaching in street or rank backdrop softly blurred, minibus and traders out of focus, or a classroom with one bold sketch on the board. never still - counts on his fingers, sketches a curve in the air, steps toward the camera to make a point Not looking at camera. Documentary feel, natural light, static camera or slow push-in, 8 seconds.

negative_prompt: face drifting from the reference image, changing age, changing skin tone, changing hairline, morphing wardrobe, warping hands, extra fingers, jittering eyes, lip-sync mismatch, whip pans, orbiting camera, speed ramps, slow motion, cartoon, illustration, 3d render, cgi, airbrushed skin, waxy skin, plastic sheen, over-saturated colours, HDR halos, extra fingers, malformed hands, distorted ears, text, watermark, logo, subtitles, teeth artefacts, dead eyes, American classroom props, chalkboard gibberish, unreadable equations, board crowded with writing, invented mathematical notation, holding two pieces of chalk, duplicated props, generic stock-photo smile
